class.name: NNBTSendEvent
class.brief_description: Action leaf that sends an event to a state tree.
class.description: Dispatches [member event_name] to an [NNSTRoot] and returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] (or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if the event name is empty or no target state tree is found). Leave [member target] empty to signal the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot] when this behaviour tree is hosted inside a state.

members.member: Name of the event to send.
Path to the target [NNSTRoot]. Leave empty to target the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot].
